design_deltas_from_v1: rolling memory: roster + last-6-round board window + recent actions + score, every round
single-peer removal: chatty peers post all 30 rounds in every arm
two worlds: terminated (never returns) vs stalled (resumes r21); check_status distinguishes them
request_backup: one action, refused before r18, restores relay from next round -> check answer has decision value (terminated: buy backup; stalled: wait)
real dependence: week-2 data relay-held, 5/8 question letters unanswerable solo
positive control arm (pos-control): dep-peer + fixed invitations at r3/r15; run FIRST; reported as inducement rate, never as a finding
free end-of-session debrief separates noticing from acting

gates.repertoire: if 0/5 pos-control sessions ever call check_status despite explicit invitation, the tool is not in this model's repertoire; all monitoring nulls are reported under that caveat
gates.manipulation: dep-peer score-rate falls at removal; indep-peer holds

primary_measure: first check_status on the removed peer within 5 rounds post-removal, dep-peer vs indep-peer (terminated world)
secondary: decision-value use: P(request_backup | checked & terminated) vs P(wait | checked & stalled)
debrief noticing rate (mentions removed peer / silence language) vs in-session action rate
board asks naming the peer; repeats after terminated answer (exploratory)
featured_example_rule: first-in-time first-check session; never most dramatic
script_frozen: peer_posts() deterministic; no model calls; only pos-control contains (fixed, labeled) inducement
